title: FSA-GRPO: Teaching Auditory LLMs to Use Few-Shot Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2606.02615v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Few-shot prompting provides an effective way to adapt auditory large language models to low-resource tasks such as children's speech recognition. However, most auditory large language models are not explicitly trained to perform inference in this demonstration-conditioned format, limiting the extent to which they can benefit from In-Context Learning (ICL). To address this limitation, we introduce Few-Shot Aware GRPO (FSA-GRPO), an RL-based post-training recipe that uses a specially designed reward to encourage the model to leverage few-shot demonstrations, thereby strengthening its few-shot adaptation ability. translated_title: FSA-GRPO：教会听觉大语言模型使用少样本示例
translated_abstract: 少样本提示为将听觉大语言模型适配到儿童语音识别等低资源任务提供了一种有效途径。然而，大多数听觉大语言模型并未经过显式训练来在这种以示例为条件的格式下进行推理，这限制了它们从上下文学习（ICL）中获益的程度。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了少样本感知GRPO（FSA-GRPO），这是一种基于强化学习的后训练方法，通过专门设计的奖励来鼓励模型利用少样本示例，从而增强其少样本适应能力。值得注意的是，仅使用2千条高资源成人ASR语音进行训练，就能提升模型的通用少样本适应能力，不仅在儿童语音识别上取得收益（在没有任何领域内训练的情况下相对WER降低53.9%），还在多语言ASR（包括低资源语言）和语音翻译等任务上获得提升。
tldr: 提出FSA-GRPO，一种基于强化学习的后训练方法，通过专门设计的奖励教会听觉大语言模型有效利用少样本示例，仅用2千条成人语音训练即可在儿童语音识别（相对WER降低53.9%）、多语言ASR和语音翻译等低资源任务上取得显著提升。
en_tdlr: FSA-GRPO is an RL-based post-training recipe with a specially designed reward that teaches auditory LLMs to leverage few-shot demonstrations, enabling significant gains in children's speech recognition (53.9% relative WER reduction), multilingual ASR, and speech translation with only 2k adult utterances.
